senses.definition: (colloquial) A friend, buddy, mate, cobber; someone to hang around with.
examples: Little Timmy's out playing with his pals.

quotes.text: "Mob job. The Mafia has a sample of the drug for the first time, thanks to me and my pal Ng. Until now, it always self-destructed before they could get to it. So I guess they're analyzing it or something. Trying to make an antidote, maybe."

senses.definition: (colloquial) An informal term of address, often used ironically in a hostile way.
examples: Don't you threaten me, pal – I'll report you to the police.

quotes.text: Michael De Santa (Ned Luke): You forget a thousand things every day, pal. Make sure this is one of 'em.
